_about: ElevenLabs voices for the recorded audio (scripts/audio/build_audio.py). 'n' is the narrator: words, examples, expressions, listening passages, prayers. Every other key is a speaker name from the conversations (data/talk cast). A speaker missing here is read by the narrator. Changing a voice id makes new files for that speaker; delete the old ones with --prune.
